**Site or board**
URL of the board (not of a specific posting).

**Source group**
`bigTech` / `ats` / `remote` / `research` / `custom`

**What the scout reported**
The `rejected` entry or the error, if any.

**What changed, if you know**
Login wall, CAPTCHA, new URL scheme, JSON endpoint moved, ...

**Checklist**
- [ ] The site is an official careers page or a public ATS board (no login-walled or scraped sources)
